emergence.summary: The commonest inherited ataxia, an autosomal-recessive neurodegeneration. Frataxin (FXN) is a small mitochondrial protein that ACCELERATES iron-sulfur (Fe-S) cluster biogenesis (it binds and allosterically activates the NFS1 cysteine-desulfurase assembly complex and chaperones iron), so Fe-S-dependent enzymes (aconitase, respiratory-chain complexes) and oxidative-phosphorylation capacity depend on it. The disease is driven by an intronic GAA triplet-repeat expansion in FXN that epigenetically silences transcription -> frataxin is DEFICIENT -> Fe-S cluster biogenesis and mitochondrial bioenergetics are UNDER-driven -> the emergent axis falls (progressive spinocerebellar and sensory ataxia, plus hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and diabetes). This is read as a DEFICIENCY-driven neurodegeneration -- the contrast to the kit's toxic-aggregate neurodegenerations (Huntington HTT gain-of-function, TTR amyloid), where a toxic species is REMOVED; here a lost function must be RESTORED, so the corrective direction is UP. The clean and honest point of this entry is the LEAD approved drug: omaveloxolone is an Nrf2 (NFE2L2) activator that boosts the antioxidant/mitochondrial gene programme and improves cellular resilience to the oxidative stress that frataxin loss causes -- it is DOWNSTREAM and does NOT restore frataxin (the same Rett/trofinetide discipline: an approved, corrective-direction, symptomatic agent that does not touch the causal switch). The SWITCH-LEVEL lever is to REPLACE frataxin -- frataxin-restoring AAV gene therapy and frataxin protein/mRNA approaches are investigational. Dimethyl fumarate (an approved Nrf2-activating drug in other diseases) is recorded as a downstream, repurposing candidate, not a switch lever. The gamma read is of the FXN promoter switch STRUCTURE; the causal lesion is the intron-1 GAA repeat expansion (a structural/epigenetic lesion), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: mitochondrial Fe-S cluster biogenesis / oxidative-phosphorylation capacity (cerebellar, sensory-neuron and cardiomyocyte bioenergetics) -- a deficiency axis

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: FXN encodes frataxin, a mitochondrial iron-binding protein that ACCELERATES iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis by binding/activating the NFS1-ISCU-ISD11(LYRM4) cysteine-desulfurase complex and donating iron. It is the rate-enhancer (accelerator) of Fe-S assembly; its loss removes that drive -> Fe-S enzymes and respiratory-chain function are under-driven -> the bioenergetic axis falls (axis DOWN). Located 9q21.11 (OMIM 606829). NCBI official symbol FXN. Autosomal recessive. The disease allele is an intron-1 GAA triplet-repeat expansion that silences transcription (heterochromatinisation); a minority carry a coding/point LOF allele on one chromosome. The repeat/epigenetic lesion is outside the promoter firewall.
per_gene.src: Campuzano 1996 Science 271:1423 (FXN GAA expansion identifies Friedreich ataxia); Tsai 2010 Biochemistry 49:9132 (frataxin activates the NFS1 cysteine-desulfurase / accelerates Fe-S assembly)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: activate NRF2 (block KEAP1-mediated degradation) -> raise the antioxidant / mitochondrial gene programme -> improve cellular resilience and bioenergetic output toward normal (axis UP). DOWNSTREAM and symptomatic -- does NOT restore frataxin or correct the FXN switch itself.
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] downstream-compensation magnitude not derived from sequence; symptomatic -- does not correct the FXN switch
levers.src: Lynch 2021 Ann Neurol 89:212 (MOXIe Part 2, omaveloxolone in FRDA); omaveloxolone (Skyclarys) FDA Feb 2023, EMA 2024 -- first disease-modifying therapy approved for Friedreich ataxia

levers.mechanism_grade: [O] downstream effect magnitude not derived from sequence; repurposing candidate, not a switch lever
levers.src: Jasoliya 2019 / Hui 2024 (dimethyl fumarate raises frataxin/ mitochondrial biogenesis in FRDA models; repurposing trials)

levers.push_direction: restore frataxin expression at/above threshold -> re-accelerate Fe-S cluster biogenesis -> raise mitochondrial bioenergetic output (axis UP). The switch-level corrective: it targets the deficient gene itself, unlike the downstream Nrf2 agent.
levers.agent_class: frataxin-restoring gene therapy (AAV-FXN) / frataxin protein- or mRNA-replacement
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored-frataxin level / cell fraction not derived from sequence; over-supply caution noted (frataxin dosage is biologically constrained)
levers.src: Ocana-Santero 2021 (AAVrh.10/AAV-FXN frataxin gene-therapy programmes for FRDA, preclinical/early clinical)

falsifiers.claim: frataxin (FXN) loss lowers Fe-S-enzyme activity and mitochondrial bioenergetic output (axis DOWN)
falsifiers.falsifier: an FXN loss-of-function genotype that RAISED aconitase / Fe-S-enzyme activity or respiratory capacity, or frataxin restoration that LOWERED them, refutes the deficiency (axis-DOWN) direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: aconitase / Fe-S-cluster-enzyme activity and mitochondrial respiratory capacity versus frataxin level in patient fibroblasts, iPSC-derived neurons/cardiomyocytes, and mouse models

falsifiers.claim: restoring frataxin is the SWITCH-LEVEL corrective direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if re-expressing frataxin failed to improve Fe-S-enzyme activity / mitochondrial function, the replace-FXN lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: aconitase activity and oxidative-phosphorylation readouts in response to frataxin re-expression in FRDA cells/models

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
